'''Chun Wa Wong''' is a physicist.

Wong earned a Bachelor of Science from the University of California, Los Angeles in 1959, followed by a Master of Arts and PhD at [[Harvard University]] in 1960 and 1965, respectively. He returned to UCLA as faculty and was granted emeritus status upon retirement.<ref>{{cite news |title=Chun Wa Wong |url=https://www.pa.ucla.edu/faculty-websites/wong.html |access-date=1 April 2026 |publisher=University of California, Los Angeles Department of Physics and Astronomy}}</ref> Wong was elected a fellow of the [[American Physical Society]] in 1977.<ref>{{cite news |title=APS fellow archive |url=https://www.aps.org/funding-recognition/aps-fellowship?q=Chun%20Wa%20Wong&af=true |access-date=1 April 2026 |publisher=American Physical Society}}</ref>
